question: The Commonwealth Fencing Championship 2022 was hosted by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**United Kingdom**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Commonwealth Fencing Championship 2022 was hosted by the **United Kingdom**.
 
• The event brought together athletes from various Commonwealth countries to compete in the sport of fencing.
 
• The championship is an important event in the Commonwealth sporting calendar, promoting sportsmanship and international cooperation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The United Kingdom has a rich history in the sport of fencing, with many prominent fencers hailing from the country.
 
• Fencing is a traditional sport that has been part of the Commonwealth Games since its inception.
 
• The Commonwealth Fencing Championship is held every four years and is governed by the Commonwealth Fencing Federation.
 
• The competition includes events in all three disciplines of fencing: foil, epee, and sabre.
